description: The CLI built from this commit finds the Daemon and says hello with its token, and the Daemon, of another protocol version, refuses it with protocol_version_unsupported before any other message.

error.message: This Client speaks protocol 0.1, and this engine speaks 1.0: it accepts 1.0 to 1.0.

data.hint: Upgrade the Client to one that speaks protocol 1.x.
